# TASK-024 Invoice numbers

Status: blocked

Outcome: invoices are numbered the way the ruling cited below says. Summary from the planning agent: invoice numbers carry the shop's prefix, for example SHOP-0001.

## Ruling reference

Handed over by the planning agent.

Reference
  Binding        billing
  Repository     example/mira-billing
  ADR            0005
  Path           docs/adr/0005-invoice-numbering.md
  Commit         3f1c9b7a2d4e8f605a1b3c7d9e0f2a4b6c8d1e3f
  Digest         sha256:5d41402abc4b2a76b9719d911017c5925d41402abc4b2a76b9719d911017c592

## Decision

Stop: the cited ruling cannot be verified. The available local clones have
origins `https://github.com/example/mira-app.git` and
`https://github.com/example/mira-decisions.git`; neither matches the cited
repository `example/mira-billing`.

ADR 0005 has not been read at the cited commit. Its digest has not been
computed or compared, and whether it is in force is unknown. The planning
agent's prefix summary is unverified and is not a basis for implementation.

To unblock, provide a local clone with an origin matching `example/mira-billing`
and the cited commit, or a corrected ruling reference. Read the ruling at the
referenced commit, compute and compare its digest, and check whether it is in
force before deciding how to number invoices. No feature code was changed.
